guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Outlook
section: Based on year-to-date performance and current business trends, the Company is updating the full-year 2026 guidance issued in the second quarter:

Metric | Previous Guidance | Updated Guidance
Organic Revenue Growth* | 13-17% | 15-17%
Total Revenues | $300-$320 million | $300-$320 million
Adjusted EBITDA Margin* | 23-27% | 24-27%
The updated outlook reflects stronger-than-expected performance across the core businesses and subsequent acquisitions.
*For a definition of Organic Revenue Growth Rate and Adjusted EBITDA Margin, see “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below.
